topics.name: Low-resource multilingual and historical NLP
topics.summary: Sparse supervision is addressed with native corpora, language-aware modeling, and task-specific benchmarks spanning bilingual medical QA, Tangkhul-English translation, dialectal resources, and historical text extraction.

topics.name: Speech representation, dialects, and conversational processing
topics.summary: Speech encoders and audio pipelines are tested across Japanese and Mandarin variation, singing, meetings, and spoken dialogue. Articulatory probing, denoising, codebook refinement, lyric-pitch alignment, and vocal-cue analysis target robust representations under expressive or noisy conditions.

topics.name: Controllable expressive speech synthesis and translation
topics.summary: Controllable speech synthesis and translation separate pronunciation, accent, prosody, emotion, and speaker identity. Disentangled conditioning, adaptive decoders, zero-shot generation, and structured evaluation improve intelligibility while preserving expressive cues.

topics.name: Scholarly text mining and research analytics
topics.summary: Computational analyses of scholarly records support paper summarization, research-impact estimation, method and entity extraction, and theorem dependency mapping. Prompted generation and graph-based representations make literature access and meta-research more searchable and interpretable.

topics.name: Clinical medical image reconstruction, segmentation, and quality
topics.summary: Medical image pipelines combine anatomical structure, cross-modality information, and efficient attention or diffusion to restore scans, segment small or fetal structures, and assess image quality. Evaluations emphasize tensor validity, tractography, boundary detail, and visibility of clinically relevant anatomy.

topics.name: Clinical multimodal imaging and medical vision-language models
topics.summary: CT and MRI systems join visual evidence with reports, patient variables, or region hypotheses, while surgical-video resources support procedural question answering. Cross-modal attention and verification improve clinical prediction, though external testing still exposes generalization limits.

topics.name: Biomedical retrieval and knowledge-grounded decision support
topics.summary: Biomedical assistants use dense or graph retrieval, longitudinal patient context, structured vocabularies, and source provenance to answer complex questions and support medication decisions. Recurring safeguards include evidence checks, trust weighting, and explicit links between predictions and knowledge.

topics.name: Information retrieval and retrieval-augmented generation
topics.summary: Retrieval research adapts routing, reranking, sparse matching, query reformulation, and evidence assembly to corpus scale and query ambiguity. Graph, modular, multimodal, accelerator-backed, and citation-aware systems are compared for relevance, latency, provenance, privacy, and correctness.

topics.name: EEG representation learning and clinical decoding
topics.summary: EEG decoders organize noisy neural signals with physiological concepts, spectral and complexity features, and geometry-aware attention. Screening for cognitive impairment and brain-computer-interface control benefit from more stable representations and more inspectable feature contributions.

topics.name: Interpretable affective and behavioral signal modeling
topics.summary: Text, keystroke, facial-motion, and review data are modeled to infer sentiment, emotion, depression, or motor-related behavior. Factorized topics, pretrained visual features, motion descriptors, and explanation tools help separate useful signals from sarcasm, rating habits, and individual variation.

topics.name: Industrial visual and welding inspection
topics.summary: Industrial inspection combines color, geometry, optical computation, and process physics to detect 3D defects or infer laser-weld penetration and seam quality. Zero-shot, self-supervised, domain-adapted, and spatiotemporal models reduce labeling demands while improving transfer across operating conditions.

topics.name: Remote sensing and environmental mapping
topics.summary: UAV, orthophoto, terrain, LiDAR, optical, and satellite data support pose localization, dense prediction, biomass estimation, and flood mapping. Distillation, state-space encoders, taxonomy-aware detection, topological descriptors, and multimodal fusion address scale, regional shift, and interpretability.

topics.name: Geometric deep learning and equivariant architectures
topics.summary: Graph and vision transformers gain structural priors through communicability coordinates and roto-reflection equivariance. The shared approach makes relational geometry explicit so attention can preserve long-range similarity and symmetry under transformations.

topics.name: Geometric novel-view synthesis and depth reconstruction
topics.summary: Novel-view and stereo systems combine real endoscopic geometry, forward warping, residual prediction, global or multiscale matching, and rendering-based diagnostics. The studies target faster single-image reconstruction and depth estimation that remains reliable in degraded or synthetic scenes.

topics.name: Controllable 3D and 4D generation
topics.summary: Controllable 3D and 4D generation uses mesh-texture synchronization, skeletal or point-track guidance, and structured physical checks. Vehicle appearance, articulated motion, and video plausibility are evaluated with explicit geometry and trajectory constraints rather than appearance alone.

topics.name: Video generation, stylization, and long-range consistency
topics.summary: Long-form and interactive video generators improve efficiency through reverse-synthesized training data, windowed inference, and teacher/self-forced distillation. The resulting systems target stylization, streaming generation, world-model rollouts, and consistency of subjects and scenes across extended outputs.

topics.name: Spatial image editing and restoration
topics.summary: Image editing and scene restoration use masks, cross-attention, optics-based correspondences, and support-aware residuals to constrain changes spatially. The methods preserve object placement, stereo structure, and cross-view coherence during 2D dragging, deblurring, and 3D Gaussian editing.

topics.name: Structured latent generative modeling
topics.summary: Generative pipelines expose structured latent variables through reusable variational components, masked representations, and flow-based semantic modeling. Separating global structure from detail improves reuse and lets decoders handle fine appearance after the main transformation.

topics.name: Visual generative-model safety and adversarial attacks
topics.summary: Visual generators are studied under adversarial prompts, targeted perturbations, diffusion backdoors, and concept-removal interventions. Benchmarks and internal filtering seek safeguards that resist harmful image-to-video behavior or poisoned synthetic data without destroying legitimate editing and generation.

topics.name: Temporal video understanding and action safety
topics.summary: Temporal video models anticipate objects, retain evidence under fixed memory, build time-grounded scene graphs, and flag unsafe or procedurally incorrect actions. Datasets, online compression, and disagreement signals support safer reasoning over long or changing visual sequences.

topics.name: Multimodal grounding and evidence-based reasoning
topics.summary: Multimodal models are trained or tested on visual crops, audio cues, forensic evidence, Earth-observation streams, and preference data. Contrastive alignment, token-level distillation, cross-modal verification, and controlled grounding tasks expose and reduce reliance on unsupported language priors.

topics.name: Multimodal model evaluation and reliability
topics.summary: Evaluation suites vary scene complexity, metadata, modality order, OCR corruption, audio composition, and grader randomness to measure context use. Repeated trials and facet-level controls reveal failure modes and reproducibility gaps hidden by single accuracy numbers.

topics.name: Representation-level vision-language interpretability
topics.summary: Cross-view tests and sparse-autoencoder analyses examine whether vision-language features encode geometry in a steerable, interpretable way. Probes of latent factors, unusual inputs, and clinically meaningful image patterns connect apparent capability with internal shortcuts and transfer limits.

topics.name: Synthetic media detection
topics.summary: Image and speech forensics focus on local artifacts rather than only whole-sample judgments. A lightweight gradient-based visual front end and frame-sensitive speech post-training target practical detection of synthetic media on constrained devices and foundation models.

topics.name: Multilingual LLM safety and policy alignment
topics.summary: Multilingual safety work maps toxicity risks across languages and converts natural-language policies into selective alignment data. The emphasis is broad linguistic coverage, harm reduction, and retention of legitimate expression rather than uniform suppression.

topics.name: LLM safety evaluation and red teaming
topics.summary: Safety assessors use multi-role red teaming, controlled wrappers, hidden-state refusal signals, and compact classifiers to test jailbreak and harmful-output detection. Calibration against human labels and adversarial cases remains important because automated judges can be brittle.

topics.name: LLM behavioral reliability and mechanistic auditing
topics.summary: Language-model audits vary interaction duration, incentives, prompt framing, memory loss, and rationale visibility while also probing internal response dispositions. They measure manipulation, trust calibration, developmental risk, unsupported conclusions, and late-stage persona or refusal mechanisms.

topics.name: Efficient language-model training, compression, and inference
topics.summary: Efficiency methods reduce cost through sparsity, selective context, bidirectional or masked training, quantization, pruning, distillation, and one-pass importance scoring. Results track end-to-end reasoning, retrieval, forgetting, storage, and inference behavior instead of assuming arithmetic savings imply equal utility.

topics.name: LLM reasoning optimization and credit assignment
topics.summary: Reasoning optimization replaces coarse rollout comparison with uncertainty rewards, solver feedback, critic estimates, and sibling-trajectory attribution. Medical VQA and mathematical tasks show how richer signals can improve exploration and assign credit more reliably.

topics.name: Mathematical and algorithmic reasoning in language models
topics.summary: Controlled multilingual math tests and internal activation probes examine how language models form multi-step solutions and sequence predictions. Position-sensitive behavioral studies and language-specific continued training distinguish genuine algorithmic transfer from coverage and readout artifacts.

topics.name: LLM agents, tool use, and self-improvement
topics.summary: Agentic systems coordinate supervisors, role-specific experts, tools, code or theorem services, iterative dataset creation, and self-improvement signals. Their training and evaluation emphasize decomposition, executable feedback, likelihood-based progress measures, and recovery when schemas or environments change.

topics.name: Agent evaluation, verification, and compliance automation
topics.summary: Agent evaluation combines executable tasks, item calibration, reward and claim verification, GUI uncertainty, fault recovery, and IT-compliance knowledge graphs. The shared goal is measurable, auditable completion with safe rejection and deterministic checks where language judgments are insufficient.

topics.name: Code-model generalization and software engineering
topics.summary: Code-model studies test transfer across task distance and changing API versions, while enterprise evidence examines agent-assisted development and repository-level optimization. Results separate near from far generalization and show that tool or documentation context can matter more than release labels.

topics.name: Interactive AI learning and educational environments
topics.summary: Interactive environments are used to build human skills and infer learning outcomes, not only to score agents. Adaptive coaching encourages independent drone-racing performance, while multi-agent gameplay traces connect financial-literacy behavior with later mastery measures.

topics.name: Adaptive and structured reinforcement learning
topics.summary: Reinforcement-learning systems preserve plasticity, diagnose deployment mismatch, and impose structure on search or multi-agent decisions. Value-factorization repair, meta-evolution, spatial propagation, Pareto preferences, team-goal factorization, equilibrium bounds, and variance-aware policy updates improve adaptation and credit assignment.

topics.name: Applied stochastic optimization for resource and portfolio decisions
topics.summary: Sequential decision methods use bounded lookahead, learned feasible decoders, and structured financial or energy models to accelerate planning under constraints. Applications include order fulfillment, portfolio allocation, commodity spreads, energy markets, and electric-bus scheduling, with attention to feasibility and value sharing.

topics.name: Safety assurance for autonomous and AI systems
topics.summary: Autonomous systems pair learned policies with formal shields, runtime fallbacks, adaptive fault handling, external authorization, attestations, and fail-closed logs. Spacecraft guidance and broader high-impact agent execution illustrate how independent checks can contain unsafe actions during adaptation.

topics.name: Robust and explainable control
topics.summary: Control studies quantify coordination under stochastic topology changes and translate closed-loop behavior into fuzzy, model-agnostic rules. Digital-twin ranking objectives and event-triggered optimization further show how control decisions can be made both resource-aware and easier to inspect.

topics.name: Multi-robot coordination and decentralized planning
topics.summary: Multi-robot systems coordinate mapping, inspection, choreography, and wireless networking under bandwidth, interference, computation, and safety constraints. Information compression, skill reuse, scene-aware planning, and fast policy updates support heterogeneous teams and larger swarms.

topics.name: Robust robot localization and semantic mapping
topics.summary: Mobile robots combine inertial, LiDAR, visual, and semantic cues for robust localization and mapping. Subspace-aware weighting, magnetic-field maps, high-rate odometry, object reconstruction, and semantic exploration address degenerate geometry and changing environments.

topics.name: Multimodal sensing and event/LiDAR perception
topics.summary: Sensing systems fuse RGB-D, tactile, event, LiDAR, radar, histology, guided-wave, strain, and spatial-genomics signals across hardware and domains. New benchmarks, adversarial robustness, synthetic transfer, and few-shot adaptation test whether spatial features survive viewpoint, sensor, and material changes.

topics.name: Robot manipulation perception and data-efficient learning
topics.summary: Manipulation learners use moving-target trajectories, language-grounded masks, depth completion, hand pose, muscle signals, and cross-embodiment motion priors. Simulation refinement and brief human demonstrations supply contact or dynamics information before task-specific optimization, improving transfer with limited labels.

topics.name: Adaptive and robust robot manipulation policies
topics.summary: Robot policies are adapted with low-rank specialist libraries, residual conditioning, value-filtered updates, force or terrain constraints, and fault-conditioned experts. The methods target distribution shift, actuator failures, polishing stages, and quadruped stair climbing while retaining feasible behavior.

topics.name: Hierarchical and compositional robot manipulation
topics.summary: Long-horizon manipulation is organized through language-conditioned rewards, dynamic expert mixtures, contact-flow planning, reusable stages, and whole-task skill composition. Real-robot evaluations emphasize transfer, recovery, and assembly performance as objects and environments change.

topics.name: Shared autonomy, humanoid control, and embodied interaction
topics.summary: Human-robot systems combine wearable physical assistance, language-vision-action locomotion, energy-aware propulsion control, asynchronous tracking, haptic embodiment, and literature-scale HRI support. The common concern is useful autonomy that respects physical feasibility, timing limits, and human agency.

topics.name: Robust optimization and planning for robots
topics.summary: Robotic planning uses model-predictive optimization, disturbance layers, GPU-batched nonlinear programs, controller-guided replay, and belief-space reachability. These tools seek feasible trajectories and stable feedback when dynamics, observations, or execution conditions are uncertain.

topics.name: Social navigation and dynamic-scene planning
topics.summary: Dynamic-scene navigation links language-level goals with relational scene representations, dense spatiotemporal costs, human-intention cues, and prompt-controlled pedestrian simulation. The combined evaluations test socially aware motion in traffic and crowds rather than isolated waypoint reaching.

topics.name: Closed-loop planning for robots and autonomous vehicles
topics.summary: Embodied agents convert observations and language into actions through behavior-aware manipulation, aerial verification, adaptive computation time, unified perception-action models, and plant-checked outputs. Autonomous-driving planners add selective semantic reasoning and declarative trajectory constraints for traceable real-time decisions.

topics.name: Physics-guided computational imaging
topics.summary: Inverse imaging methods combine physical forward models with spectral, iterative, or diffusion machinery for haze, spatially varying blur, wavefront distortion, and EUV mask design. Their shared priority is accurate recovery under noise while keeping computation and constraints explicit.

topics.name: Learned geometry and physical dynamics
topics.summary: Learned representations are tested against known robot configuration manifolds and used to advect volumetric features for 3D dynamics prediction from video. Both studies connect generative modeling with geometric or physical consistency instead of treating scenes as unstructured tokens.

topics.name: Statistical diagnostics and uncertainty calibration
topics.summary: Statistical reliability improves when anomalies are decomposed into variable and interaction effects and when classification intervals account for small or clustered samples. Deployment-focused forecasting adds temporal separation, online adaptation, and route-aware residuals to improve uncertainty calibration.

topics.name: Environmental forecasting
topics.summary: Atmospheric and ocean models use learned latent structure, generative sampling, and compute-efficient sequence architectures to forecast weather and sea state. The evaluations balance predictive skill, speed, and calibrated uncertainty for operational use.

topics.name: Hardware-aware machine learning acceleration
topics.summary: Hardware-aware learning systems optimize kernels, memory traffic, retrieval scoring, synchronization, and mixture-of-experts execution across GPUs, FPGAs, and compilers. Profiling, roofline analysis, code-generation search, and expert transfer reduce latency or training cost without losing task quality.

topics.name: Advanced semiconductor packaging assurance
topics.summary: Advanced packaging research combines nanoscale mechanical security primitives with AI-guided nondestructive X-ray inspection. The papers link tamper resistance, experiment selection, and manufacturability for complex assemblies.

topics.name: Fairness and measurement validity
topics.summary: Fairness and discourse audits treat measured outcomes as products of language, uncertainty, social structure, and the instrument itself. The work warns that lexical proxies can reverse rhetorical meaning and that apparent disparities need structural validation.

topics.name: Privacy and security of learned models
topics.summary: Learned-model security studies cover gradient inversion, split training, membership inference, poisoning, influence analysis, perturbation audits, and unlearning. They evaluate both what attackers recover and how defensive mechanisms affect accuracy, communication, and model behavior.

topics.name: Synthetic and imbalanced learning for clinical data
topics.summary: Clinical and federated learning methods address scarce, missing, private, or skewed labels with diffusion-generated cohorts, embedding-space mixtures, feature-dependent relabeling, and synthetic minority data. Analyses focus on treatment effects, diagnosis, finite-sample behavior, and bias from imperfect rebalancing.

topics.name: Optimization for structured neural parameters
topics.summary: Optimization methods account for parameter geometry by separating weight scale from orientation and extending spectral-style updates to higher-order tensors. Structured operations aim to improve training behavior without treating every parameter block as an ordinary vector.

topics.name: Automated theory discovery in cognitive science
topics.summary: Agentic cognitive-science systems generate competing theories, fit them to simulated or crowdsourced behavior, design discriminating experiments, and refine successors. Their results recover known strategies while producing explanations that can outperform literature-based baselines.

topics.name: Human-centered interactive AI and accessibility
topics.summary: Interactive AI studies examine layout-flexible text entry, augmented emotion regulation, virtual-reality timing, wellbeing recommendations, visual-neglect assistance, and creative practice. Across these settings, usefulness depends on adapting to human goals, perception, and judgment rather than optimizing an isolated model score.

topics.name: Probabilistic optimization and learning dynamics
topics.summary: These studies improve learning through transport-based inference, input-aware initialization, constrained hyperparameter selection, black-box optimization, robust Monte Carlo, physics-informed networks, and gradient interventions. The common focus is how update geometry, uncertainty, and structure affect generalization and stability.

topics.name: Language resources and text analysis across cultures
topics.summary: Language-focused resources cover Buddhist and historical corpora, coreference disagreement, literary translation, abstractive summarization, narrative transformation, and Mandarin tone analysis. The papers connect dataset design and linguistic structure with more reliable analysis across genres, eras, and languages.

topics.name: Clinical imaging synthesis and diagnostic reasoning
topics.summary: Clinical vision systems generate or interpret structured anatomy across glioma MRI, blastocyst microscopy, histopathology, X-ray assemblies, pulmonary embolism scans, MRI view rendering, and fMRI task relations. Their shared challenge is preserving medically meaningful structure while learning from limited or heterogeneous evidence.

topics.name: Vision-language robustness and adaptation
topics.summary: Vision-language studies test open-vocabulary recognition, brain-vision alignment, noisy test-time adaptation, multimodal photography, confidence-aware inputs, transferability, mixture-of-experts routing, prompt fusion, and scientific-figure generation. Evaluation centers on grounded evidence and behavior under distribution or modality changes.

topics.name: Visual anomaly, restoration, and generative-media robustness
topics.summary: Visual models are challenged with relational anomalies, point-cloud defects, face-swap attacks, hiding operations, appearance transfer, federated backdoors, diffusion poisoning, and information loss in turbid scenes. The studies seek representations that preserve useful structure while exposing or resisting visual manipulation.

topics.name: Search, recommendation, and cost-aware document processing
topics.summary: Search and recommendation pipelines adapt computation to query or document difficulty through segmentation-aware routing, generative ranking, poisoned-corpus attribution, calibrated relevance cascades, fair ranking, encrypted retrieval, GPU MaxSim kernels, and hierarchical document classification. The goal is useful results under cost, privacy, and trust constraints.

topics.name: Agent memory, tool safety, and governance
topics.summary: Agent research studies memory roles, tool-call constraints, role consistency, penetration testing, medical error correction, safety judging, surveillance resistance, GUI grounding, vulnerability patching, decentralized trust, protocol governance, smart-contract security, and evaluation environments. Together they measure whether agents remain useful, inspectable, and safe in changing contexts.

topics.name: Robot platforms, locomotion, and physical control
topics.summary: Robotics papers develop locomotion and embodied control for evolved multi-agent motion, passive quadrupeds, preference-based movement, inertial odometry, prosthetic feet, animated controllers, continuum arms, and humanoid tennis. They emphasize feasible dynamics, online correction, and transfer from learned policies to physical systems.

topics.name: Robotic perception, calibration, and embodied mapping
topics.summary: Robotic perception combines event-adaptive planning, multi-camera calibration, radar shadow geometry, tactile sensing, spatial-semantic tracking, magnetic disaster mapping, learned world models, crowd simulation, voxel representations, V2X compression, and photon timing. The shared concern is reliable spatial state under sensor limits and dynamic scenes.
